treaty_name: Convention between the Republic of Slovenia and the Kingdom of Denmark for the avoidance of double taxation with respect to taxes on income and on capital (2001)
eif_quote: FURS "Seznam veljavnih mednarodnih pogodb o izogibanju dvojnega obdavčevanja ... ki se uporabljajo v letu 2026" (Država | Objava | Začetek uporabe KIDO | Združeno besedilo | Začetek uporabe MLI): DANSKA | MP, št. 6/02 | 1. 1. 2003 | SLO ENG | za davke pri viru v RS 1. 1. 2020 na Danskem 1. 1. 2020 za druge davke v RS 1. 7. 2020 na Danskem 1. 1. 2021 |
source_title: Synthesised text of the MLI and the SI-DK Convention 2001 (Slovenian Ministry of Finance, English)

rates.article: Article 10(2)(a) as modified by MLI art. 8(1)
rates.quote: 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends where such holding is being possessed for an uninterrupted period of no less than one year and the dividends are declared within that period; and] Subparagraphs a) and b) of paragraph 2 of Article 10 of the Convention shall apply only if the ownership conditions described in those provisions are met throughout a 365 day period that includes the day of the payment of the dividends (for the purpose of computing that period, no account shall be taken of changes of ownership that would directly result from a corporate reorganisation, such as a merger or divisive reorganisation, of the company that holds the shares or that pays the dividends).
d) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of such royalties.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of the Convention, a benefit under the Convention shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of the Convention.

notes: Convention has effect for fiscal years following the year of entry into force (Art. 31(2)); FURS: applied from 1.1.2003. 5% dividend tier: company holding directly >=25% of capital for an uninterrupted period of at least one year with dividends declared within that period (treaty), plus MLI art. 8(1) 365-day period from MLI WHT effect 1 January 2020. Not modelled: Art. 10(2)(b) 5% for a Danish-resident company partner in a Danish partnership holding >=25% (Denmark as residence State only); Art. 10(2)(c) 5% for recognised pension funds (Protocol).
